extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet identifies 15N10 as an N-channel 100 V fast-switching MOSFET with HL branding; the manufacturer field preserves the exact extraction-job manufacturer target HL.
Curve points are manual readings from plotted traces on page 3 and are approximate digitizations of visible points; no points were interpolated between plotted readings.
The Ciss table row does not print complete test conditions; the shared condition block for Coss and Crss specifies VDS = 25 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1.0 MHz.
RDS(on) typical and maximum values are transcribed for both published VGS and ID pairs, preserving the table semantics and pulse-test note.
The PDF metadata title is N-15N10-TO252-V2.0; the datasheet page itself does not print a separate revision field, so V2.0 is retained as the revision identifier.
omission_reason: Figures 3 (RDS(on) versus drain current), 4 (body-diode), and 7-11 were not digitized; the output, transfer, capacitance, and gate-charge curves were usable and extracted.
